## UI polish: Invoice 1042 card 19 fixes across spacing, typography, contrast, hierarchy, states, layout, motion and tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `.card` `padding: 13px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Spacing**: `h2` `margin: 0 0 5px` is off the scale. Now `margin: 0 0 var(--space-4)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Spacing**: `button` `padding: 6px 10px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Typography**: `h2` `font-size: 22px` is off the scale. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-2xl)` (24px). (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **Typography**: `h2` had no line-height. Now `line-height: var(--line-height-heading)` (1.25). (R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 6. **Typography**: `h2` used the browser's default weight of 700, which has no token. Now `font-weight: var(--font-weight-strong)` (600), so the card uses exactly the file's two weights. (R-ui-polish-8, R-ui-polish-20) 7. **Typography**: `p` `font-size: 13px` is below the 16px body minimum. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-md)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 8. **Typography**: `p` had no line-height and no max-width. Now `line-height: var(--line-height-body); max-width: var(--measure)`. (R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 9. **Contrast**: `p` `#999999` on `#ffffff` is 2.85:1. Now `var(--color-text-muted)` (#4a6462), 6.38:1. (R-ui-polish-4, R-ui-polish-20) 10. **Hierarchy**: "Download PDF" was a second filled button. Now it is an outline secondary button: `background: transparent; color: #2563eb; border: var(--border-width-hairline) solid #2563eb`, 5.17:1. "Pay now" stays the one primary action. (R-ui-polish-5) 11. **States**: buttons had no hover style. Now "Pay now" goes to `#1d4ed8` on hover (6.70:1), and "Download PDF" changes its text and border to `#1d4ed8` (6.70:1). (R-ui-polish-6) 12. **States**: buttons had no focus style. Now `:focus-visible` has `outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 13. **States**: buttons had no disabled style. Now `:disabled` has `opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed`. (R-ui-polish-6) 14. **Layout**: buttons were about 30px tall. Now `min-height: var(--size-target-min); min-width: var(--size-target-min)`. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 15. **Motion**: `transition: box-shadow .3s` is now `transition: box-shadow var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-standard)`, and a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` block turns transitions off. (R-ui-polish-9, R-ui-polish-20) 16. **Tokens**: these colours already match a token, so each now uses it: card `#ffffff` is `var(--color-surface-raised)`, heading `#202d2c` is `var(--color-text-default)`, button text `#fff` is `var(--color-action-primary-text)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 17. **Tokens**: card `border: 1px solid #e5e7eb` is now `border: var(--border-width-hairline) solid var(--color-border-default)` (#d2dfde). (R-ui-polish-20) 18. **Tokens**: `border-radius: 5px` is now `var(--radius-md)` on the card and `var(--radius-control)` on the buttons (both 6px). (R-ui-polish-20) 19. **Tokens**: `font-family: system-ui` is now `var(--font-family-sans)`.
